12.24.14.a.m: Soma must not be drunk by one who has not been invited;

12.24.14.b.m: he surely becomes deprived of the drinking of soma.

12.24.15.a.m: He addresses [the other] by his ritual title: 'So-and-so, invite [me]!'

12.24.16.a.m: He asks for an invitation from those who partake in the same course,

12.25.1.a.m: He partakes of the Aindravāyava draught from the eastern side, bringing it close to the vital breaths.

12.25.1.b.m: He partakes of the Maitrāvaruṇa draught from the eastern side, bringing it close to the two eyes.

12.25.1.c.m: Moving it all around, he partakes of the Āśvina draught, bringing it close to the two ears.

12.25.2.a.s: avyutsṛjantau pātraṃ dviraindravāyavaṃ bhakṣayato bhakṣayanti bhakṣayati vā /
12.25.2.a.d: अव्युत्सृजन्तौ पात्रं द्विरैन्द्रवायवं भक्षयतो भक्षयन्ति भक्षयति वा ।
12.25.2.a.m: Without letting go of the vessel, the two partake twice of the Aindravāyava draught, or [all of them] partake, or [each] partakes.

12.25.3.a.m: With regard to those [texts where it says], "the two partake," the meaning is the adhvaryu and the hotṛ.

12.25.3.b.m: Where it says, "they partake," the meaning is the two adhvaryus and the hotṛ.

12.25.3.c.m: Where it says, "he partakes," the meaning is each one by himself.

12.25.4.a.m: Having partaken, they pour the residue into the hotṛ's goblet, whether the goblet has been partaken of or not partaken of.

12.25.5.a.m: Then they let go of the vessel.

12.25.6.a.m: He places a piece of the sacrificial cake into the vessel of the Aindravāyava draught;

12.25.6.b.m: curdled milk into that of the Maitrāvaruṇa draught;

12.25.7.a.m: He sets them down on the northern track of the southern cart for the soma-offerings.

12.25.7.b.s: ā tṛtīyasavanātpariśere yajñasya saṃtatyā iti vijñāyate
12.25.7.b.d: आ तृतीयसवनात्परिशेरे यज्ञस्य संतत्या इति विज्ञायते
12.25.7.b.m: "They remain until the third pressing for the continuity of the sacrifice," it is recognized in tradition.

12.25.8.a.m: At this point some teach the cutting off of the portions of the iḍā.

12.25.9.a.m: At this point the hotṛ invokes the iḍā.

12.25.9.b.m: The holders of the goblets lift up their goblets.

12.25.9.c.m: The hotṛ's goblet touches the iḍā.

12.25.10.a.m: Those who partake in the archetypal rite consume [the iḍā] once it is invoked.

12.25.11.a.m: He sets aside a piece of the sacrificial cake for the acchāvāka.

12.25.12.a.m: In the Āgnīdhra fire-shed they consume the remains of the sacrificial offerings.

12.25.13.a.s: atra savanīyānāṃ śākhāpraharaṇaṃ vājinacaryāntarvedi yajamānasya vedābhimarśanaṃ piṣṭalepaphalīkaraṇahomau patnyā vedaprāsanaṃ praṇītāsu mārjanamupaveṣodasanaṃ kapālavimocanamiti kriyante
12.25.13.a.d: अत्र सवनीयानां शाखाप्रहरणं वाजिनचर्यान्तर्वेदि यजमानस्य वेदाभिमर्शनं पिष्टलेपफलीकरणहोमौ पत्न्या वेदप्रासनं प्रणीतासु मार्जनमुपवेषोदसनं कपालविमोचनमिति क्रियन्ते
12.25.13.a.m: At this point the following rites belonging to the press-offerings are performed: throwing the branch into the fire, the performance with the whey, touching the grass bush inside the altar ground by the sacrificer, the two offerings of the flour-paste and the chaff, casting the grass bush by the wife, sprinkling with the consecrated waters, throwing away the wooden poker, and removing the potsherds.

12.25.14.a.m: For an incidental rule does not postpone a specific one belonging to these.

12.25.16.a.m: The hotṛ obtains his share of partaking by virtue of the vaṣaṭ-call;

12.25.17.a.m: the adhvaryu by virtue of offering and pressing [the soma];

12.25.18.a.m: They also obtain a share of partaking by virtue of the designation [of the goblet].

12.25.19.a.m: The hotṛ partakes once of all the goblets;

12.25.21.a.m: The subordinate hotṛ priests partake twice of their own respective goblets.

12.25.22.a.m: The adhvaryu partakes in return once of those that have been partaken of, in the original order.

12.25.24.a.m: They swell those [goblets] that have been partaken of with the verse: "Swell, let [strength] gather unto you..."

12.25.26.a.m: The first two pressings have two nārāśaṃsa rounds;

12.25.26.b.m: the third pressing has one nārāśaṃsa round.

12.25.27.a.m: They place those that have been partaken of and swelled underneath the southern cart for the soma-offerings, in the hanging frame.

12.26.1.a.d: उपविशत्यच्छावाको बहिः सदसो ऽग्रेण स्वं धिष्णियम्
12.26.1.a.m: The acchāvāka sits down outside the sadas in front of his own dhiṣṇiya hearth.

12.26.2.a.m: Offering him the piece of sacrificial cake, [the adhvaryu] says: "O acchāvāka, speak what you have to say!"

12.26.3.a.s: yadāsya vijānātyupo asmānbrāhmaṇānbrāhmaṇā hvayadhvamityathainaṃ hotra āvedayatyacchāvāko vā ayamupahavamicchate taṃ hotarupahvayasveti
12.26.3.a.d: यदास्य विजानात्युपो अस्मान्ब्राह्मणान्ब्राह्मणा ह्वयध्वमित्यथैनं होत्र आवेदयत्यच्छावाको वा अयमुपहवमिच्छते तं होतरुपह्वयस्वेति
12.26.3.a.m: When he understands from him, "O brahmins, invite us brahmins!", then he reports him to the hotṛ: "This acchāvāka desires an invitation; invite him, O hotṛ!"

12.26.4.a.s: uta no gāva upahūtā upahūteti hoturabhijñāyonnīyamānāyānubrūhyacchāvākasya camasādhvaryo unnayasvobhayataḥ śukraṃ kuruṣveti
12.26.4.a.d: उत नो गाव उपहूता उपहूतेति होतुरभिज्ञायोन्नीयमानायानुब्रूह्यच्छावाकस्य चमसाध्वर्यो उन्नयस्वोभयतः शुक्रं कुरुष्वेति
12.26.4.a.m: Upon recognizing the hotṛ's [words], "And to us the cows are invited, invited!", [the adhvaryu calls]: "Recite for [the soma] being drawn up! Camasādhvaryu of the acchāvāka, draw it up; make it clear on both sides!"

12.26.5.a.m: Taking it and going to the āhavanīya, having called for the response and when the response has been given, he gives the ritual call: "Acchāvāka, recite the consecratory verse!"

12.26.6.a.m: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, he brings the partaking share.

12.26.7.b.m: He does not ask for an invitation from him.

12.26.7.c.m: If he should ask for an invitation from him, he should say to him: "Partake!"

12.26.8.a.s: bhakṣitāpyāyitamantarā neṣṭurāgnīdhrasya ca camasau sādyitvartugrahaiḥ pracarataḥ
12.26.8.a.d: भक्षिताप्यायितमन्तरा नेष्टुराग्नीध्रस्य च चमसौ साद्यित्वर्तुग्रहैः प्रचरतः
12.26.8.a.m: Having set down the two goblets of the neṣṭṛ and the āgnīdh, which have been partaken of and swelled, between [the two fires], they proceed with the seasonal draughts.

12.26.9.a.m: They are drawn from the wooden trough;

12.26.10.a.m: Over the remnants of the earlier ones they draw the subsequent ones.

12.26.11.a.d: पूर्वो ऽध्वर्युर्गृह्णाति जघन्यः प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयामगृहीतो ऽसि मधुश्चेत्येतैः प्रतिमन्त्रम्
12.26.11.a.m: The adhvaryu draws first, the pratiprasthātṛ last, with each respective mantra: "You are taken with a support; you are Madhu..."

12.26.12.a.m: "For Madhu you, for Mādhava you," some teach.

12.26.13.a.m: All [mantras] have the upayāma-formula at the beginning.

12.26.14.a.m: They should not cross behind one another.

12.26.14.b.m: The adhvaryu enters on the southern side in the well-known manner.

12.26.14.c.m: In the established manner, the pratiprasthātṛ [enters] by the north.

12.26.16.a.m: As the adhvaryu is entering, the pratiprasthātṛ passes around [him] holding the draught;

12.26.17.a.m: For the first three [draughts], the adhvaryu issues the ritual call: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formula!”

12.26.18.a.m: Having turned around the mouths of both vessels, the adhvaryu [issues the ritual call] for two [draughts]: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formulas!”

12.26.19.a.m: Having turned them back again, the adhvaryu once [issues the ritual call]: “Prompt [the hotṛ] with the season-formula!”

12.27.1.a.m: Twelve, thirteen, or fourteen [draughts] are drawn.

12.27.2.a.m: When there are twelve, the first two are drawn together;

12.27.3.a.m: When there are thirteen, drawing and offering of the last two are done together.

12.27.4.a.m: Likewise when there are fourteen, of the first two and of the last two.

12.27.5.a.m: With “Thou art Saṃsarpa, for Aṃhaspatya thee,” the thirteenth and fourteenth are drawn separately.

12.27.6.a.m: Having recognized [the calls]: “O two adhvaryus, recite the consecratory verse!” [and] “O master of the house, recite the consecratory verse!”, in both cases he issues the further ritual call: “O hotṛ, recite the consecratory verse for this!”

12.27.7.a.m: Likewise the master of the house at the end of his own ritual call.

12.27.8.a.m: Having poured the remnants of the offerings together as in the case of the two-deity [draughts], the adhvaryu draws the draught for Indra and Agni with the unemptied vessel.

12.27.8.b.m: “O Indra and Agni, come to the pressed [soma]” are the [verses for] drawing and settling.

12.27.8.c.m: The pratiprasthātṛ brings the portion for partaking.

12.27.9.a.m: Both adhvaryus partake according to the vaṣaṭ-call.

12.27.10.a.m: The cleansing of all soma-vessels that have been partaken of takes place at the mārjālīya [hearth].

12.27.11.a.s: etatpātramādāyādhvaryuḥ sadobile prāṅmukha upaviśyeḍā devahūriti śastraṃ pratigariṣyañjapati
12.27.11.a.d: एतत्पात्रमादायाध्वर्युः सदोबिले प्राङ्मुख उपविश्येडा देवहूरिति शस्त्रं प्रतिगरिष्यञ्जपति
12.27.11.a.m: Taking up this vessel and sitting down facing east at the opening of the sadas, the adhvaryu, about to make the response to the recitation, whispers: “Iḍā, the invoker of the gods...”

12.27.12.a.s: adhvaryo śoṃsāvomiti hoturabhijñāya pradakṣiṇamāvartamānaḥ śoṃsā moda iveti pratyāhvayate /
12.27.12.a.d: अध्वर्यो शोंसावोमिति होतुरभिज्ञाय प्रदक्षिणमावर्तमानः शोंसा मोद इवेति प्रत्याह्वयते ।
12.27.12.a.m: Having recognized the hotṛ's [call], “Adhvaryu, let us two recite: om,” turning clockwise he calls in response: “Recite! May it delight [us]! May it be so!”

12.27.13.a.m: Holding the season-cup, standing facing west at the opening of the sadas, he makes the response;

12.27.14.b.m: “Om othā moda iva” at the pauses.

12.27.15.a.s: othā moda ivaṃ hotarmoda ivamothā moda ivomiti vikalpante
12.27.15.a.d: ओथा मोद इवं होतर्मोद इवमोथा मोद इवोमिति विकल्पन्ते
12.27.15.a.m: “Othā moda ivaṃ,” “hotar moda iva,” and “om othā moda ivom” are options.

12.27.17.a.s: śoṃsā moda ivauthā moda iveti vyāhāveṣūbhayaṃ karoti
12.27.17.a.d: शोंसा मोद इवौथा मोद इवेति व्याहावेषूभयं करोति
12.27.17.a.m: At the calls to recite, he does both: “Śoṃsā moda iva” and “authā moda iva.”

12.27.18.a.m: Having responded to the recitation, the adhvaryu takes up the draught;

12.27.19.a.m: Having called for attention and received the response, he issues the ritual call: “Reciter of the uktha, recite the consecratory verse for the soma!”

12.28.1.a.m: They shake the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets] following the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call.

12.28.3.a.m: The partaking of the draught has been explained;

12.28.3.b.m: likewise the partaking, swelling, and settling of the Nārāśaṃsas.

12.28.4.a.m: He draws the Vaiśvadeva [draught] with the Śukra vessel.

12.28.4.b.m: “O protectors, upholders of the people” are the [verses for] drawing and settling.

12.28.5.a.m: With “It has been released, it has been released,” he initiates the chant with two blades of sacrificial grass.

12.28.6.a.s: iḍāyai hiṅkuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai stuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyā iti purastādājyānāṃ yajamāno japati caturhotāraṃ ca vyācaṣṭe
12.28.6.a.d: इडायै हिङ्कुरु तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै स्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्या इति पुरस्तादाज्यानां यजमानो जपति चतुर्होतारं च व्याचष्टे
12.28.6.a.m: “Make the hiṅ-sound for Iḍā! Chant the prelude for her! Sing praise to her! For my obtaining of her!”—before the Ājya [chants] the sacrificer whispers this and recites the Caturhotṛ formula.

12.28.7.a.m: And while praise is being chanted, he whispers the Caturhotṛ formula.

12.28.8.a.m: “Having recited the Caturhotṛs, he sings [the chant] with the Ājyas,” thus it is known from tradition.

12.28.9.a.m: When the chant has been sung, the response to the recitation, the draught, and the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets] are as in the case of the Indra-Agni [draught], except for the season-vessel.

12.28.10.a.m: The goblets are those of which all partake.

12.28.11.a.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi devebhyo devā yuvamukthyebhya ukthyā yuvamityukthyapātreṇokthyatṛtīyaṃ gṛhītvaiṣa te yonirmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tveti sādayitvā punarhavirasīti sthālīmabhimṛśati
12.28.11.a.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि देवेभ्यो देवा युवमुक्थ्येभ्य उक्थ्या युवमित्युक्थ्यपात्रेणोक्थ्यतृतीयं गृहीत्वैष ते योनिर्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वेति सादयित्वा पुनर्हविरसीति स्थालीमभिमृशति
12.28.11.a.m: Having drawn the third part of the Ukthya [draught] with the Ukthya vessel with: “Thou art taken with a support; I take thee pleasing to Mitra and Varuṇa; gods to gods, worthy of ukthas, ye two are worthy of ukthas,” and having settled it with: “This is thy womb; for Mitra and Varuṇa thee,” he touches the trough with: “Again art thou an oblation.”

12.28.12.a.s: yanmukhyāścamasā bhavanti tasya pratigṛṇāti taṃ ca pratibhakṣayati
12.28.12.a.d: यन्मुख्याश्चमसा भवन्ति तस्य प्रतिगृणाति तं च प्रतिभक्षयति
12.28.12.a.m: He responds for the one whose goblets are headed [by his own], and he partakes alongside him.

12.28.13.a.m: Having drawn the goblets headed by the Maitrāvaruṇa goblet, he initiates the chant as before.

12.28.14.a.m: When the chant has been sung, having responded to the recitation as before, the adhvaryu takes up the draught;

12.28.14.c.m: Having called for attention and received the response, he issues the ritual call: “Reciter of the uktha, recite the consecratory verse for the somas!”

12.28.14.d.m: At the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, they offer.

12.28.15.a.m: In this way, henceforth, is the procedure regarding the groups, with the exception of the Nārāśaṃsa [goblets].

12.28.16.a.s: devebhyastvā devāyuvaṃ pṛṇajmi yajñasyāyuṣa iti mukhye saṃpātamavanayati
12.28.16.a.d: देवेभ्यस्त्वा देवायुवं पृणज्मि यज्ञस्यायुष इति मुख्ये संपातमवनयति
12.28.16.a.m: With 'To the gods, longing for the gods, I unite thee for the life of the sacrifice', he pours the residue into the chief [goblet].

12.29.1.a.m: 'If the adhvaryu desires: "May I endow myself with the glory of the sacrifice"'—[this] has [already] been stated.

12.29.2.a.m: In this way the two subsequent rounds are prescribed.

12.29.3.a.m: With these two the pratiprasthātṛ performs [the ritual actions].

12.29.4.a.s: indrāya tveti dvitīye grahaṇasādanau saṃnamatyardhaṃ cokthyaśeṣasya gṛhṇāti /
12.29.4.a.d: इन्द्राय त्वेति द्वितीये ग्रहणसादनौ संनमत्यर्धं चोक्थ्यशेषस्य गृह्णाति ।
12.29.4.a.m: In the second [round], he modifies the drawing and setting-down [formulas] with 'For Indra thee', and draws half of the remainder of the Ukthya [draught].

12.29.4.b.m: He touches the vessel as before.

12.29.4.c.m: He fills the goblets of which the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's goblet is the chief.

12.29.5.a.m: He does not accompany with a chant an unconsumed goblet.

12.29.6.a.m: The pratiprasthātṛ does not consume from the upright vessel.

12.29.7.a.m: He pours the residue into the chief [goblet].

12.29.8.a.s: indrāgnibhyāṃ tveti tṛtīye grahaṇasādanau saṃnamati sarvaṃ cokthyaśeṣaṃ gṛhṇāti /
12.29.8.a.d: इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वेति तृतीये ग्रहणसादनौ संनमति सर्वं चोक्थ्यशेषं गृह्णाति ।
12.29.8.a.m: In the third [round], he modifies the drawing and setting-down [formulas] with 'For Indra and Agni thee', and draws the entire remainder of the Ukthya [draught].

12.29.9.a.s: pūtabhṛto bila udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitraṃ vitatya ya ādhavanīye rājā taṃ sarvaṃ pūtabhṛtyavanīyācchāvākacamasamukhyāṃścamasānunnayansarvaṃ rājānamunnīya daśābhiḥ kalaśau mṛṣṭvā nyubjati
12.29.9.a.d: पूतभृतो बिल उदीचीनदशं पवित्रं वितत्य य आधवनीये राजा तं सर्वं पूतभृत्यवनीयाच्छावाकचमसमुख्यांश्चमसानुन्नयन्सर्वं राजानमुन्नीय दशाभिः कलशौ मृष्ट्वा न्युब्जति
12.29.9.a.m: Having spread over the mouth of the pūtabhṛt the strainer with its fringes pointing northward, and having poured all the king [Soma] that is in the ādhavanīya into the pūtabhṛt, he fills the goblets of which the Acchāvāka's goblet is the chief; having drawn all the king [Soma] into goblets, having wiped the two jars with the fringes, he inverts them.

12.29.10.a.m: He pours the residue into the chief [goblet].

12.29.11.a.s: ukthaśā ityāha prātaḥsavanaṃ pratigīrya śastraṃśastraṃ vā
12.29.11.a.d: उक्थशा इत्याह प्रातःसवनं प्रतिगीर्य शस्त्रंशस्त्रं वा
12.29.11.a.m: He says: 'Ukthaśāḥ', after responding to the morning pressing, or after each recitation.

12.29.12.a.m: Without hurrying, they perform the first two pressings.

12.29.13.a.s: agniḥ prātaḥsavane pātvasmāniti saṃsthite savana āhutiṃ juhoti
12.29.13.a.d: अग्निः प्रातःसवने पात्वस्मानिति संस्थिते सवन आहुतिं जुहोति
12.29.13.a.m: When the pressing is concluded, he offers an oblation with: 'May Agni protect us at the morning pressing'.

12.29.14.a.m: He issues the call: 'Director, impel!', or 'Impel!'.

12.29.16.a.m: By the way they creep forward, by that they creep out.

12.29.17.a.m: The morning pressing is concluded; the morning pressing.

13.1.1.a.m: The midday pressing is performed, beginning with the pressing [of Soma].

13.1.2.a.m: Its procedure is explained by the morning pressing.

13.1.3.a.m: Having poured [water] out from the vasatīvarī waters with the Hotṛ's goblet, he prepares the nigrābhyā waters.

13.1.4.a.m: The draughts for two deities, the season draughts, and the ladle offerings do not exist [here].

13.1.5.a.m: Having untied the king [Soma], he gives the soma-turban to the Grāvastut.

13.1.6.a.m: Without being prompted, he recites the verses to the pressing stones.

13.1.7.a.m: The great pressing is just the same.

13.1.9.a.m: And while pressing, they shout together: 'Ihâ3 iha!' ('Here, here!').

13.1.10.a.m: In the middle round of the last pressing, they make a loud noise with 'Bṛhat, bṛhat!' ('Loudly, loudly!').

13.1.11.a.s: uttame 'bhiṣave 'bhiṣave rājanyasaṃbhṛte devā grāvāṇa indurindra ityavādiṣuḥ /
13.1.11.a.d: उत्तमे ऽभिषवे ऽभिषवे राजन्यसंभृते देवा ग्रावाण इन्दुरिन्द्र इत्यवादिषुः ।
13.1.11.a.m: In the last pressing, when the king [Soma] has not yet been collected at the pressing, [with]: 'The divine pressing stones have sounded: "The drop, Indra!"

13.1.11.b.m: They have brought Indra down from the highest distance,

13.1.11.c.m: To this assembly from the wide midspace.

13.1.11.d.s: ā subhūtamasuṣavurbrahmavarcasaṃ ma āsuṣavuḥ samare rakṣāṃsyavadhiṣurapahataṃ brahmajyasyeti pratiprasthātā grāvṇo 'numodate
13.1.11.d.d: आ सुभूतमसुषवुर्ब्रह्मवर्चसं म आसुषवुः समरे रक्षांस्यवधिषुरपहतं ब्रह्मज्यस्येति प्रतिप्रस्थाता ग्राव्णो ऽनुमोदते
13.1.11.d.m: They have pressed out welfare, they have pressed out spiritual luster for me; in combat they have slain the demons; struck down is [the foe] of him who suppresses the sacred word'—the pratiprasthātṛ gladdens the pressing stones.

13.1.12.a.m: Having portioned out the animal cake, [he portions out] the cakes connected with the pressings, excluding the curds.

13.1.13.a.m: Having performed the ritual with that, he performs the ritual with the cakes connected with the pressings.

13.1.14.a.m: The Sviṣṭakṛt and the iḍā, however, are common.

13.1.16.a.m: From the collecting [of the pressed soma] up to the continuous stream being made, the adhvaryu draws the draughts.

13.2.1.a.m: The Śukra and Manthin [draughts], then the Āgrayaṇa [draught], from three continuous streams.

13.2.2.a.m: Having poured out from the Āgrayaṇa vessel, he makes the second continuous stream.

13.2.3.a.m: Having drawn the Ukthya [draught], the two Marutvatīya [draughts].

13.2.3.c.m: The Ukthya [draught] in the middle, the two Marutvatīya [draughts] on both sides, say some.

13.2.4.a.m: The adhvaryu draws the first Marutvatīya draught with his own season cup, with: 'Possessed of the Maruts...';

13.2.4.b.m: the pratiprasthātṛ the subsequent one with his own, with: 'O Indra, possessed of the Maruts...'

13.2.5.a.m: Some teach drawings addressed to another deity for those two in the case of a hated rival.

13.2.6.a.m: From 'The stream ceases' up to 'the ekadhana [waters] according to purpose', [the actions] begin up to the pañcahotṛ formula.

13.2.7.a.s: grahāvakāśaiḥ śṛtaṃkāraiścopasthāya vaipruṣānsapatahotāraṃ ca hutvā bahiṣpavamānavanmādhyaṃdinaṃ pavamānaṃ sarpanti
13.2.7.a.d: ग्रहावकाशैः शृतंकारैश्चोपस्थाय वैप्रुषान्सपतहोतारं च हुत्वा बहिष्पवमानवन्माध्यंदिनं पवमानं सर्पन्ति
13.2.7.a.m: Having paid reverence with the grahāvakāśa formulas and the śṛtaṃkāra formulas, and having offered the drop-oblations and the saptahotṛ formula, they creep to the midday pavamāna chant just as to the bahiṣpavamāna chant.

13.2.8.a.s: traiṣṭubhaḥ panthā rudrā devatāvṛkeṇāparipareṇa pathā svasti rudrānaśīyeti sarpaṇe vikāraḥ
13.2.8.a.d: त्रैष्टुभः पन्था रुद्रा देवतावृकेणापरिपरेण पथा स्वस्ति रुद्रानशीयेति सर्पणे विकारः
13.2.8.a.m: The modification in the creeping is: 'The path of the triṣṭubh; the Rudras are the deity; along an unwolfish, unintercepted path may I safely attain the Rudras'.

13.2.9.a.s: uttareṇa havirdhānaṃ gatvā dakṣiṇena mārjālīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśyāgreṇa hotāramadhvaryuryajamānaścāvatiṣṭhete /
13.2.9.a.d: उत्तरेण हविर्धानं गत्वा दक्षिणेन मार्जालीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य पूर्वया द्वारा सदः प्रविश्याग्रेण होतारमध्वर्युर्यजमानश्चावतिष्ठेते ।
13.2.9.a.m: Having gone to the north of the havirdhāna shed, having gone around the mārjālīya dhiṣṇiya hearth by the south, having entered the sadas hall by the eastern door, the adhvaryu and the sacrificer stand in front of the hotṛ.

13.2.9.b.s: dakṣiṇenottareṇa vā praśāsturdhiṣṇiyaṃ parītyodgātāro mādhyaṃdinena pavamānena stuvate
13.2.9.b.d: दक्षिणेनोत्तरेण वा प्रशास्तुर्धिष्णियं परीत्योद्गातारो माध्यंदिनेन पवमानेन स्तुवते
13.2.9.b.m: Having gone around the hearth of the praśāstṛ to the south or north, the chanters praise with the midday pavamāna chant.

13.3.1.a.s: jyotiṣe hiṅkuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai stuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyā iti purastānmādhyaṃdinātpavamānādyajamāno japati /
13.3.1.a.d: ज्योतिषे हिङ्कुरु तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै स्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्या इति पुरस्तान्माध्यंदिनात्पवमानाद्यजमानो जपति ।
13.3.1.a.m: Before the midday pavamāna chant, the sacrificer murmurs: 'Make the hiṅ-sound for the light! Sing the prelude for it! Chant for it! For my attainment of it!'.

13.3.1.b.m: He recites the caturhotṛ or pañcahotṛ formula.

13.3.1.c.s: jyoktyai hiṅkuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai stuhi tasyai me 'varuddhyā iti ca /
13.3.1.c.d: ज्योक्त्यै हिङ्कुरु तस्यै प्रस्तुहि तस्यै स्तुहि तस्यै मे ऽवरुद्ध्या इति च ।
13.3.1.c.m: And: 'Make the hiṅ-sound for life! Sing the prelude for it! Chant for it! For my attainment of it!'.

13.3.1.d.s: sūyamāne ca caturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ cā japati /
13.3.1.d.d: सूयमाने च चतुर्होतारं पञ्चहोतारं चा जपति ।
13.3.1.d.m: And while it is being pressed, he murmurs the caturhotṛ and pañcahotṛ formulas.

13.3.1.e.m: And during the middle strophic verse, he mutters the second ascension formula.

13.3.1.f.s: stute 'dhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyatyagnīdagnīnvihara barhi stṛṇīhi puroḍāśām̐ alaṃkuru pratiprasthātardadhigharmeṇānūdehīti
13.3.1.f.d: स्तुते ऽध्वर्युः संप्रेष्यत्यग्नीदग्नीन्विहर बर्हि स्तृणीहि पुरोडाशाम्̐ अलंकुरु प्रतिप्रस्थातर्दधिघर्मेणानूदेहीति
13.3.1.f.m: When the chant has been chanted, the adhvaryu gives the ritual call: 'Agnīdh, lay out the fires; strew the sacrificial grass; decorate the sacrificial cakes; pratiprasthātṛ, come forth with the warm curd-offering!'

13.3.2.a.m: In the āgnīdhra shed, the pratiprasthātṛ takes the warm curd-offering.
